correctness.rationale: For p>=7 and exactly three nonzero entries in each input, prime Fourier row uncertainty gives p+1-k_x surviving frequencies for each active delay. Summing overlap sizes 9 yields S >= |F-G|(p+1)-9. Cauchy-Davenport forces >=5 delays, and >=6 forces S>=6p-3. Vosper applies when |F-G|=5<=p-2, forcing two common-step 3-term progressions. On normalized supports 0,1,2 the outer STFT rows have no zeros, two adjacent linear rows each have at most one and the central quadratic at most two; the precise count 5p-1_{r_- in mu_p}-1_{r_+ in mu_p}-h follows. Vieta gives z1z2=r_-r_+, excluding three cancellations from two distinct central roots with one side root; hence the 5p-3 double-root classification. Explicit nonzero coefficient witnesses attain every 5p-4..5p and 6p-3. The finite floating-point checker was inspected but tolerance-based detections are only consistency checks, not exact or unbounded proof.
